posts.title: Impressions after my first Vipassana meditation retreat
posts.description: This is a summary I wrote to a friend after my first 10-day Vipassana meditation course I sat, in South Korea in 2025. Vipassana was a very powerful experience. I had done little research about it and did not realise the intensity of the experience. It was very special, powerful, insightful and definitely one of the most difficult things I have done. posts.title: Why I wanted to study physics
posts.description: I decided I wished to pursue a PhD in condensed-matter physics when I was 18-years-old. It was unusual to already know how I wanted to spend the next seven to eight years of my life. My teenage years were spent becoming more and more fascinated by the power of mathematics at describing the world around us. I was sure that in theoretical physics there lay the key to understanding reality as it is.

posts.title: Why I studied materials science
